description: Foundation: bun+TypeScript project scaffold, domain types, the 7 service interfaces, config/env handling, and the local INFRASTRUCTURE providers (Storage, TraceStore, SearchIndex, DocumentExtractor) plus shared field-extraction. This is the base every later feature builds on. Depends on nothing. Mirrors plan.md items 1-2.
steps: Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\package.json: name agilia-mvp, "type":"module", scripts { "dev":"bun run src/server/index.ts", "start":"bun run src/server/index.ts", "typecheck":"tsc --noEmit", "build":"tsc --noEmit", "test":"bun test", "seed":"bun run scripts/seed.ts" }, devDependencies typescript + @types/node + bun-types, dependencies hono + zod. (AWS SDK deps are added in FEAT-004.)

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\tsconfig.json: strict true, target ES2022, module/moduleResolution bundler (or NodeNext), noEmit true, skipLibCheck true, types ["bun-types","node"], include ["src","tests","scripts"].

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\.env.example documenting AIDLC_PROVIDER=local, PORT=8787, and AWS_* placeholders (region, bucket, table names) with a comment that the local provider needs none of them.

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\src\domain\types.ts with: Located<T> ({ value:T, location:{ page?,section?,line?,charStart?,charEnd? }, evidence?:string }), ExtractedData (entidad, procesoId, objeto, modalidad, valorSinIva, valorTotalConIva, cdpNumero, cdpValor, fechaPublicacion, fechaCierre, plazoEjecucion, items:[{numero,descripcion,cantidad,marca?}], experienciaExigida, garantias — each as Located or optional), Finding (id, ruleId, severity 'LOW'|'MEDIUM'|'HIGH', category 'MISSING_FIELD'|'INCONSISTENCY'|'COHERENCE'|'FORMAT', message, evidence, location, riskAlert?:{level,reason}), RiskAlert, Decision ({id, findingId, action 'ACCEPT'|'REJECT', justification, recordedAt}), DocumentVersion, DraftSection, DraftDocument ({documentId,version,format:'markdown',sections,content}), DocumentRecord ({documentId,status,extracted,findings,alerts,versions,decisions}), SearchResult.

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\src\providers\interfaces.ts declaring DocumentExtractor (extract(input)->ExtractedData), NlpAnalyzer (analyze(text)->{entities,keyPhrases}), RuleValidator (validate(extracted)->Finding[]), DraftGenerator (generate(extracted,findings,decisions)->DraftDocument), Storage (put/get/list blobs by key), TraceStore (saveDocument/getDocument/recordDecision/addVersion/listVersions/listDecisions), SearchIndex (index(findings,documentId)/search(q)->SearchResult[]). Also export a ProviderBundle type aggregating all 7.

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\src\config.ts reading process.env with safe defaults: provider = (process.env.AIDLC_PROVIDER==='aws'?'aws':'local'), port = Number(process.env.PORT)||8787, dataDir = absolute .data path. Export a redactForLog() helper so no PII/secret values are ever logged.

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\src\rules\field-extraction.ts: pure functions that parse an estudio-previo plain-text string into ExtractedData with char-offset locations and textual evidence (regex/anchors for Entidad, Objeto, Modalidad, Presupuesto/valor sin IVA, valor total con IVA, CDP numero+valor, fechas, plazo, items with marca, experiencia, garantias). Parse Colombian currency like "$51.460.675.487" to a number. Handle missing anchors by leaving the field undefined (never throw).

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\src\providers\local\local-storage.ts: filesystem Storage under config.dataDir using bun/node fs with try/catch on every op (no silent failure); keys map to files; put/get/list.
Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\src\providers\local\local-trace-store.ts: JSON-file-backed (or in-memory with fs persistence) store implementing TraceStore for documents, decisions, versions.

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\src\providers\local\local-search-index.ts: in-memory lexical BM25-ish index over finding message+evidence; tokenize, score by term frequency / inverse doc frequency, return ranked SearchResult[] with snippet+location.

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\src\providers\local\local-document-extractor.ts: implements DocumentExtractor; decodes text (from input.text, or base64 contentBase64 treated as UTF-8/plain, with a best-effort note for PDF-as-text) and delegates to field-extraction.ts.

Create c:\Users\jparrap\AgilIA-AWS\tests\providers\local-providers.test.ts using bun:test: extractor pulls entidad/objeto/valorSinIva/cdp from a representative inline sample; storage put->get round-trips and get-missing-key returns null (not throw); search ranks a matching finding above a non-matching one and returns [] for empty index.
acceptance_criteria: `bun install` succeeds and `bunx tsc --noEmit` reports zero errors.
DocumentExtractor returns a populated ExtractedData (with locations+evidence) for the inline sample; missing fields are undefined, not errors.
No secrets hardcoded; every fs operation has error handling.
findings:
DELIVERED (bun 1.4.4, tsc clean, 13/13 provider tests pass).

FILE NAMES (exact, use .ts extensions in imports — tsconfig has allowImportingTsExtensions:true + moduleResolution:bundler + verbatimModuleSyntax:false):
- src/domain/types.ts
- src/providers/interfaces.ts
- src/config.ts

EXPORTED DOMAIN TYPES (src/domain/types.ts): SourceLocation, Located<T>, ExtractedItem, ExtractedData, FindingSeverity ('LOW'|'MEDIUM'|'HIGH'), FindingCategory ('MISSING_FIELD'|'INCONSISTENCY'|'COHERENCE'|'FORMAT'), RiskAlert, Finding, DecisionAction ('ACCEPT'|'REJECT'), Decision, DocumentVersion, DraftField, DraftSection, DraftDocument, DocumentStatus ('RECEIVED'|'EXTRACTED'|'ANALYZED'|'VALIDATED'|'DRAFTED'|'ERROR'), DocumentRecord, SearchResult. NOTE: Finding.location is SourceLocation (has optional field/page/section/line/charStart/charEnd). ExtractedData fields are ALL optional EXCEPT items:ExtractedItem[] (always present, [] when none). plazoEjecucion is Located<string> & { dias?: number }. DraftDocument.format is the literal 'markdown'.

EXPORTED INTERFACES (src/providers/interfaces.ts): ExtractorInput {filename; text?; contentBase64?}, DocumentExtractor.extract(input)->Promise<ExtractedData>, NlpResult {entities:[{text,type,score?}]; keyPhrases:[{text,score?}]}, NlpAnalyzer.analyze(text)->Promise<NlpResult>, RuleValidator.validate(extracted)->Promise<Finding[]>, DraftGenerator.generate(extracted,findings,decisions)->Promise<DraftDocument>, Storage {put/get/list} (get returns null for miss), DecisionInput {findingId,action,justification}, TraceStore {saveDocument/getDocument/recordDecision/addVersion/listVersions/listDecisions}, SearchIndex {index(findings,documentId)/search(q)}, ProviderBundle {documentExtractor,nlpAnalyzer,ruleValidator,draftGenerator,storage,traceStore,searchIndex}. FEAT-003 must implement NlpAnalyzer, RuleValidator, DraftGenerator to these signatures. FEAT-004 (providers/index.ts selector) builds a ProviderBundle; use dynamic import() for aws.

CONFIG (src/config.ts): exports loadConfig(env?), config (resolved singleton), redactForLog(value). config has {provider:'local'|'aws', port:number(default 8787), dataDir:absolute path (env AIDLC_DATA_DIR or <root>/.data), aws:{region,bucket?,documentsTable?,decisionsTable?,versionsTable?,openSearchEndpoint?}}. Server boot should call redactForLog before logging anything with PII; redactForLog redacts keys containing cdp/entidad/nombre/email/secret/token/key/etc.

FIELD-EXTRACTION (src/rules/field-extraction.ts): exports extractFields(text)->ExtractedData, parseColombianCurrency(raw)->number|undefined, normalizeDate(raw)->ISO string (best-effort, returns input if unparseable). Anchors are 'Label: value' line-based (Entidad, Proceso, Objeto, Modalidad de seleccion, Valor total sin IVA, Valor total con IVA y costos, CDP No. N por valor de $, Fecha de publicacion, Fecha de cierre, Plazo de ejecucion, Experiencia exigida, Garantias) + numbered item lines '1. desc - Cantidad: N - Marca: X'. Never throws on missing anchors. Currency: dots=thousands, comma=decimals.

LOCAL PROVIDERS: LocalStorage(baseDir=config.dataDir/blobs), LocalTraceStore(baseDir=config.dataDir/trace, JSON file per doc + in-memory cache), LocalSearchIndex (in-memory BM25, K1=1.5 B=0.75, keys by documentId::findingId). All constructors accept an optional baseDir override (used by tests). TraceStore.saveDocument backfills createdAt/updatedAt and empty arrays; recordDecision/addVersion throw if the document is unknown (call saveDocument first). addVersion assigns the next version number automatically (version is Omit'd from input).

WINDOWS/BUN QUIRKS (IMPORTANT for later test authors):
1. readdir() — even WITHOUT {withFileTypes:true} — throws EPERM on this machine's OS temp dir (os.tmpdir()). Workspace paths are fine. DO NOT create test temp dirs under os.tmpdir(); create them under <root>/.data/... instead. LocalStorage.list uses readdir+lstat (not withFileTypes) to dodge a separate Bun EPERM bug.
2. mkdtempSync needs its parent to exist (mkdirSync {recursive:true} first).
3. PowerShell terminal echoes commands and mangles stdout; redirect to a file and read it to see real output. `bunx tsc --noEmit` prints nothing on success (exit 0).

VERIFICATION RUN: `bun install` OK; `bunx tsc --noEmit` 0 errors; `bun test tests/providers` => 13 pass / 0 fail / 31 expect() calls. Removed the .data/ runtime dir the tests created so nothing is left behind.

DEPS INSTALLED: hono ^4.6.14, zod ^3.24.1 (deps); typescript ^5.7.3, @types/node ^22, bun-types ^1.1 (devDeps). AWS SDK deps deferred to FEAT-004 as planned.
